edges.reason: onlyOwner compares msg.sender with _owner to restrict privileged functions.
ifAdmin gates admin functions by comparing msg.sender to _admin().
Gateway initialize sets the owner and admin from msg.sender.
onlyOwnerOrMintAuthority checks msg.sender against owner and mintAuthority.
recoverTokens sends the ETH balance to the untrusted msg.sender.
permit uses block.timestamp to validate the signature expiry.
initializer relies on isConstructor to allow constructor initialization.
isTopLevelCall decides whether the init flags are set and reset.
changeAdmin only executes its body when ifAdmin passes.
upgradeTo only executes its body when ifAdmin passes.
upgradeToAndCall only executes its body when ifAdmin passes.
ifAdmin delegates non-admin callers to the fallback.
_delegate performs an inline delegatecall to the implementation.
_setImplementation writes the implementation slot with sstore.
_setAdmin writes the admin slot with sstore.
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls arbitrary data on the new implementation.
The proxy constructor sets the initial implementation.
The proxy constructor delegatecalls the supplied init data.
initialize delegatecalls the supplied init data.
claimTokenOwnership calls claimOwnership on the token.
transferTokenOwnership calls transferOwnership on the token.
transferTokenOwnership calls claimTokenOwnership on the new owner.
Gateway initialize claims ownership for msg.sender.
recoverTokens performs an external ETH transfer to the caller.
recoverTokens checks the recoverable token blacklist.
recoverTokens calls safeTransfer which performs a low-level token call.
callOptionalReturn performs the low-level token call.
permit recovers the holder address with ecrecover.
permit uses DOMAIN_SEPARATOR in the digest.
permit checks and increments the holder nonce.
verifySignature recovers the signer via ECDSA.recover.
verifySignature compares the recovered signer with mintAuthority.
mint verifies the mint authority signature.
mint performs external token mint calls before incrementing nextN.
mint marks the signed message hash as spent in status.
mint interacts with the token contract.
mint sends the fee to feeRecipient.
mint increments nextN after the external calls.
mint hashes its parameters via hashForSignature.
burn pulls tokens with transferFrom and calls token.burn/token.mint before nextN increments.
burn computes the fee with SafeMath.mul.
burn requires amountAfterFee to exceed minimumBurnAmount.
burn interacts with the token contract.
burn re-mints the fee to feeRecipient.
burn transfers tokens from the untrusted _msgSender().
newImplementation is written into the implementation slot.
newAdmin is written into the admin slot.
newAdmin is the target of changeAdmin.
_token selects the asset recovered by the owner.
holder is the signer whose allowance is set.
v, r and s are passed into ecrecover.
_amount determines the minted amounts and fee.
_symbol is part of the signed payload.
_nHash prevents replay of signed mint messages.
_to is the destination ledger address in the burn event.
_amount is transferred, burnt and split by the fee.
recipient is checked against the token contract address.
amount flows into the internal token transfer.
hash and signature are consumed by ecrecover.
sender is stored as the owner during initialization.

normalization_plan.reason: newImplementation is written into the implementation storage slot by _setImplementation.
newAdmin is stored in the admin slot by _setAdmin after the ifAdmin check.
newOwner becomes pendingOwner in Claimable.transferOwnership.
_token selects the ERC20 or ETH withdrawn by the owner.
holder is the signer whose allowance is granted by permit.
spender receives the allowance set by permit.
expiry is compared against block.timestamp inside permit.
nonce is validated against nonces[holder] inside permit.
v, r and s are passed straight into ecrecover inside permit.
the mint signature is verified by verifySignature.
_amount drives the fee arithmetic in gateway mint.
_recipient is the recipient of the minted tokens.
_symbol is part of the signed mint payload.
_nHash is part of the signed payload and the spent status key.
_to is emitted and validated in gateway burn.
_amount is transferred, burnt and reduced by the fee in burn.
_logic is stored as the proxy implementation.
_data is delegatecalled on the implementation during initialization.
_admin is written to the admin slot of the proxy.
_nextMintAuthority becomes the new mintAuthority.
_nextFeeRecipient becomes the new feeRecipient.
_minimumBurnAmount becomes the new burn threshold.
recipient is checked against the token contract address.
amount flows into the internal token transfer and allowance subtraction.
hash and signature are consumed by ecrecover in the ECDSA library.
sender is stored as the contract owner during initialization.
isTopLevelCall decides whether the initializing and initialized flags are toggled.
the local address and code size are used by the isConstructor check.
impl holds the implementation address read from the slot.
adm holds the admin address used by the ifAdmin comparison.
signedMessageHash is computed, consumed and marked spent in mint.
absoluteFee and receivedAmount are the fee split results of mint.
fee and amountAfterFee are the fee split results of burn.
digest is the EIP-712 hash verified inside permit.
the signed message hash and recovered signer are produced by verifySignature.
the success flag and return data come from the low-level token call.
